wiringChecks.label: Per-key English fallback
wiringChecks.detail: loadLocaleBundle deep-merges each locale over en — missing keys render English, not blank.

wiringChecks.label: Cookie persistence (refresh/navigation)
wiringChecks.detail: gh_locale written with path=/ and max-age — survives refresh and navigation.

wiringChecks.label: Server rendering reads header + cookie
wiringChecks.detail: getPageLocale reads x-gh-locale header and gh_locale cookie.

wiringChecks.label: Middleware stamps locale header
wiringChecks.detail: proxy.ts stamps x-gh-locale for server components.

wiringChecks.label: Language switcher re-renders after switch
wiringChecks.detail: Switcher writes gh_locale cookie then reloads/refreshes so server-rendered content updates.

wiringChecks.label: html lang reflects locale
wiringChecks.detail: Root layout sets <html lang> from resolved locale.

wiringChecks.label: Admin portal localization
wiringChecks.detail: Admin portal is English-only by construction (no locale plumbing). Known/possibly intentional.
